sourceTitle: Metabolic engineering of Escherichia coli to enhance L-serine biosynthesis
sourceAbstract: Abstract L-serine, an important non-essential amino acid, is widely used in the food, pharmaceutical, feed, and cosmetic industries. However, previous studies on fermentative L-serine production by Escherichia coli have mainly focused on improving titer, whereas insufficient attention has been paid to the conversion yield, limiting its industrial economic feasibility. In this study, systematic metabolic engineering was performed to improve L-serine yield. Using H5 as the parental strain, the L-serine re-uptake-related genes sstT and tdcC were deleted based on the CRISPR/Cas9 system to generate strain H8, in which the L-serine titer increased to 5.58 g/L and the conversion yield reached 0.37 g/g. Subsequently, the L-serine biosynthetic module, L-serine transport module, and cofactor supply module were individually enhanced in H8, resulting in recombinant strains H8- abc , H8- be , and H8- pntab , respectively. The resulting strains H8- abc , H8- be , and H8- pntab produced 6.40, 5.89, and 5.59 g/L L-serine, with yields of 0.43, 0.39, and 0.37 g/g, respectively. Further combination of effective strategies in the H8 chassis generated strain H8- abc-be ; however, its L-serine production decreased. Finally, H8- abc was selected for fermentation medium optimization. After optimization, the L-serine titer reached 7.20 g/L in shake-flask fermentation, with a yield of 0.48 g/g, representing a 71.84% increase compared with the starting strain H5. These results provide a useful reference for the development of efficient E. coli strains for industrial L-serine production.
titleZh: 通过大肠杆菌代谢工程增强L-丝氨酸生物合成
abstractZh: 摘要：L-丝氨酸是一种重要的非必需氨基酸，广泛应用于食品、制药、饲料和化妆品行业。然而，以往关于大肠杆菌（Escherichia coli）发酵生产L-丝氨酸的研究主要着眼于提高滴度，对转化得率关注不足，限制了其工业生产的经济可行性。本研究开展系统性代谢工程改造，以提高L-丝氨酸得率。以H5为亲本菌株，利用CRISPR/Cas9系统删除与L-丝氨酸再摄取相关的基因sstT和tdcC，获得菌株H8，其L-丝氨酸滴度提高至5.58 g/L，转化得率达到0.37 g/g。随后，分别增强H8中的L-丝氨酸生物合成模块、L-丝氨酸转运模块和辅因子供应模块，获得重组菌株H8-abc、H8-be和H8-pntab。这3株菌的L-丝氨酸滴度分别为6.40、5.89和5.59 g/L，相应得率分别为0.43、0.39和0.37 g/g。进一步将有效策略组合到H8底盘中，获得菌株H8-abc-be，但其L-丝氨酸产量下降。最后，研究者选择H8-abc进行发酵培养基优化。优化后，摇瓶发酵的L-丝氨酸滴度达到7.20 g/L，得率为0.48 g/g，相比起始菌株H5提高71.84%。这些结果为开发用于工业化生产L-丝氨酸的高效大肠杆菌菌株提供了有用参考。

sourceTitle: Development of a CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing system for the extremely thermophilic bacterium Anaerocellum bescii
sourceAbstract: Anaerocellum (f. Caldicellulosiruptor) bescii is an extremely thermophilic (Topt 75-78 °C) anaerobic bacterium and is also a highly efficient degrader of lignocellulose, making it a promising platform for metabolic engineering. To date, chromosomal genetic manipulations in A. bescii have required multistep procedures involving homologous recombination with integrating vectors and counterselection. Here, we demonstrate the first implementation of CRISPR-Cas9 genome editing in A. bescii facilitated by a thermostable Cas9 enzyme from Geobacillus stearothermophilus (GeoCas9). Delivery of heterologous CRISPR machinery via a replicating vector enabled us to individually and sequentially delete genes for lactate dehydrogenase (ldh) and pyrE in A. bescii. We then deployed this system to delete a novel target, tryptophan synthase (trpBA), generating a tryptophan auxotrophic strain of A. bescii. Using this strain, we show trpBA complementation enables selection and maintenance of a replicating vector expressing a heterologous enzymatic reporter gene.
titleZh: 极端嗜热细菌Anaerocellum bescii的CRISPR-Cas9基因组编辑系统开发
abstractZh: Anaerocellum bescii（原称Caldicellulosiruptor bescii）是一种极端嗜热的厌氧细菌，最适温度（Topt）为75—78 °C；它还能够高效降解木质纤维素，因此有望成为代谢工程平台。迄今为止，A. bescii的染色体遗传操作需要通过整合型载体介导的同源重组和反向筛选等多步骤程序完成。本研究借助来自Geobacillus stearothermophilus的热稳定Cas9酶（GeoCas9），首次在A. bescii中实现了CRISPR-Cas9基因组编辑。通过可复制载体递送异源CRISPR系统，研究者能够在A. bescii中分别及依次删除乳酸脱氢酶基因（ldh）和pyrE。随后，研究者利用该系统删除一个新的靶标——色氨酸合酶基因（trpBA），获得了A. bescii的色氨酸营养缺陷型菌株。利用这一菌株，研究者表明，trpBA互补可支持对表达异源酶类报告基因的可复制载体进行筛选和维持。

sourceTitle: Metabolism-Informed Bioreactor Model for Transferring Knowledge from Fed-batch to Continuous Biomanufacturing
sourceAbstract: Chinese hamster ovary (CHO) cells remain the dominant platform for monoclonal antibody (mAb) manufacturing, and rising demand is pushing the industry from fed-batch toward continuous operation. Continuous cultures promise sustained high cell densities and volumetric productivities, but their operation depends on reliable real-time monitoring, prediction and control. Limited intracellular observability and sparse extracellular measurements hinder this, leaving a persistent gap between mechanistic understanding and predictive deployment. Here we describe a metabolism-informed model for mAb production that embeds reactor- and intracellular-level mass balances directly within a learning architecture, while deliberately avoiding predefined kinetic rate laws and explicit steady-state assumptions. Because conservation relationships remain invariant across operating modes, this formulation provides a principled structural prior for cross-regime generalisation, positioning the model as a soft sensor for continuous bioprocesses: inferring unmeasured intracellular fluxes and one-step ahead forecasting extracellular concentrations to support process monitoring and control. Benchmarking two metabolic network sizes and three metabolic optimisation strategies, concentration predictions are indistinguishable across network sizes. Exchange flux fidelity is agnostic to solver choice, with network size mattering only for intracellular interpretability. Transferring the developed model from fed-batch to continuous operation with fine-tuning outperforming other transfer learning variants. This is consistent with the metabolic structure being invariant to mode of operation. Predicted fluxes reveal growth rate in fed-batch, rather than operating mode, as the dominant axis of metabolic variation, and identify potential regime-shift signals to guide experimental design for continuous culture characterisation. These results chart a route towards digital models sufficiently grounded in first-principles knowledge, yet adaptive for deployment under regime shifts.
titleZh: 代谢知识引导的生物反应器模型：将补料分批工艺的知识迁移至连续生物制造
abstractZh: 中国仓鼠卵巢（CHO）细胞仍是单克隆抗体（mAb）制造的主要平台，不断增长的需求正推动该行业从补料分批运行转向连续运行。连续培养有望维持高细胞密度和高体积生产率，但其运行依赖可靠的实时监测、预测与控制。细胞内状态的可观测性有限，细胞外测量又较为稀疏，阻碍了这一目标的实现，使机制认识与预测模型的实际部署之间持续存在差距。本研究提出一种由代谢知识引导的mAb生产模型，将反应器层面和细胞内层面的质量衡算直接嵌入学习架构，同时避免预设动力学速率定律和显式稳态假设。由于守恒关系在不同运行模式下保持不变，这一表述为跨工况泛化提供了基于原理的结构先验，并将模型定位为连续生物过程的软传感器：推断未测量的细胞内通量，并提前一步预测细胞外浓度，以支持过程监测和控制。研究者对两种代谢网络规模与三种代谢优化策略进行了基准比较，发现不同网络规模下的浓度预测结果无可区分的差异。交换通量的保真度与求解器选择无关，网络规模仅影响细胞内过程的可解释性。将所开发的模型从补料分批运行迁移至连续运行时，微调的表现优于其他迁移学习方案。这与代谢结构不随运行模式改变的认识一致。预测通量显示，补料分批培养中的生长速率，而非运行模式，是代谢变化的主导维度；模型还识别出可能提示工况转换的信号，可为连续培养表征的实验设计提供指导。这些结果为构建既充分建立在第一性原理知识之上、又能适应工况转换下部署的数字模型提供了一条路径。
